title: Side-plank interval practice
note: One tap requests the saved Side Planks interval timer. Follow MultiTimer’s alerts: left 30 sec, switch 5 sec, right 30 sec, rest 30 sec, then left 30 sec, switch 5 sec, right 30 sec. If configured, the initial Get ready interval adds 5 seconds. This practice does not start Watch workout recording. Confirm completion after the final hold; the page cannot read MultiTimer state.

items.name: Side planks
items.instructions: Hold for 30 seconds. Then use the 5-second interval to switch sides.

items.name: Side planks
items.instructions: Hold for 30 seconds. Rest for 30 seconds before round 2.
